subject: Deepening Your Practice - Day 3
body:
We hope you're enjoying exploring Luca!

As you continue your journey, here are some deeper questions about Master's teachings and practices:

{{exampleQuestions}}

Our library contains many teachings from Master, along with teachings from Swamiji and other Ananda ministers. Whether you're looking for guidance on meditation techniques, understanding spiritual principles, or exploring the path of Kriya Yoga, Luca, our AI assistant, is here to help.

Have you tried asking about your specific interests yet?

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
exampleQuestionPool: How does one maintain focus at the spiritual eye?
What techniques does Master give to remember God in daily activities?
What are the qualities of Christ Consciousness?
How to develop a positive quality?
